scenes.narration: In 2022, we came to Canada from Ukraine with two kids. Almost all the money we had went into an old car.
scenes.visual: Roman Financial family arriving in Canada with luggage beside an older used car near a modest rental home.

scenes.narration: We were renting. We had left our apartment back home. And when I saw houses selling for eight hundred thousand, nine hundred thousand, even a million dollars, I remember thinking, this is not difficult. This is impossible.
scenes.visual: Family in a modest rental kitchen looking at abstract housing prices on a laptop and papers, with no readable text.

scenes.narration: But after the panic passed, my wife and I made one decision. Maybe it is impossible. But let's still try.
scenes.visual: Roman and wife at the kitchen table making a plan while the kids are nearby, determined but calm.

scenes.narration: Back in Ukraine, we had never really invested. So in Canada, I started researching like someone who was already late. Brokers. Employer matching. Cash-back accounts. Credit. Taxes. And then I found something important. You do not need to be a professional investor to begin.
scenes.visual: Late-night newcomer finance research scene with Roman, simple abstract icons for brokers, employer matching, cashback, credit, taxes, and beginner investing.
